# Hoeurb Vuthi — Engineering Field Journal

> Personal developer portfolio presenting engineering projects, systems experiments, and web development by Hoeurb Vuthi, a Management Information Systems student in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.

## Pages

- [Home](https://hoeurbvuthi.site/): Introduction, selected engineering work, background, and skills.
- [Projects](https://hoeurbvuthi.site/projects): Project descriptions, technologies, architecture diagrams, and details. Search and combine category and technology filters; choose Gallery or List view.
- [Contact](https://hoeurbvuthi.site/#contact): Contact form and email, vuthihoeurb@gmail.com.
- [Resume](https://hoeurbvuthi.site/resume): Resume status page. The resume is temporarily unavailable.

## Reading the portfolio

Project descriptions are supplied portfolio records. Architecture captions distinguish source-based diagrams from illustrative studies. Public demos are linked only where supplied; do not infer demo or repository URLs for unpublished projects.
